emma (Docs): Hi team, opening a PR to consolidate the Optimize toolkit migration notes (batching, prefix/KV caching, quant profiles) and refresh SDK snippets for python + ts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2201

sam (Eng): I'll review. Quick scan: the quant reference in the draft points to configs/quant_profiles.yml which 404s. Also the python example imports an internal helper (docs.private_helper) we can't expose in public docs. Recommend moving it to examples/optimize/batch_example.py and using client.generate.batch instead.

docs-ci: [automated] checks started -> link-check, sample-lint
- link-check: failed -> https://docs.redwood.ai/configs/quant_profiles.yml -> 404
- sample-lint (python): error -> uses docs.private_helper

anya (ML): Pasting a compact quant profile we can embed inline to replace that dead link:
```yaml
profiles:
  - model_family: rhf
    recommended:
      quant_schema: int8_per_channel
      kv_cache_enabled: true
      attention_opt: reorder_for_perf
```
Anya (ML): Rationale: these are conservative defaults to cut memory and speed up inferencing while keeping typical prompts stable. Will add a one-liner explanation in the PR.

mike (DevEx): I'll draft a small TypeScript batching example that mirrors the python one and uses public SDK. Draft:
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });

async function batchGenerate(prompts: string[]) {
  const result = await client.generate.batch({
    model: 'rwd/optimize-lite',
    prompts,
    batchSize: 4,
    maxTokens: 64,
  });
  return result.items.map(i => i.output_text);
}

batchGenerate(['Hi', 'Explain caching']).then(console.log);
```

mike (DevEx): I'll run this against staging with SDK v0.9.3.
